inspection_scope: Complete data-only review of the supplied film structure, setup s1, and beat contracts b1–b6, covering rhetorical progression, narration coverage, setup boundaries, semantic centers, persistence, hierarchy, composition, and central-action legibility.

checks.evidence: Setup s1 asks one persistent house world to explain six distinct rules through an archive, diff lens, water tank, permission gate, branching pipeline, and rewind crank. These operations do not evolve one physical rule; a new mechanism is added for every proposition.

Every beat begins with the house and all previously introduced machines visible, then adds another machine while every earlier machine remains fully opaque and active. The retained archive, lens, tank, gate, pipe, and crank do not communicate the current operation's state.

By later beats, several unrelated operating groups remain active around the house while a new hero mechanism is introduced. They represent separate claims rather than repeated members of one meaningful group.

All six unrelated propositions use the same central slab, small Bot at left, fixed wide camera, paper wall/floor, subject framing, and identical depth planes. No continuity requirement justifies retaining this staging across archive, inspection, testing, permission, routing, and reversal.

Although the continuity-token list is empty, the shot contracts make the house and every accumulated machine persistent de facto continuity elements. Their stated justification is branding rather than an ordered story lifecycle, and they obscure each succeeding operation.
Obsolete machines remain fully opaque and active after their propositions finish. The plan assigns them no current story, location, action, or balance function beyond branding the argument.

There is one setup and no reset across six semantic shifts: saving, inspecting a diff, testing behavior, granting permission, routing output, and restoring prior state. The only planned reset occurs after the film ends.

Each beat introduces a new focal mechanism while all earlier mechanisms remain active and opaque. In later beats, the declared hero must compete with multiple unrelated active machines, undermining the planned dominant action at a quick glance.

The contracts specify distinct central actions that physically express the intended operations: copying a snapshot, revealing edited lines, testing for leaks, releasing a gated lever, routing a result, and retrieving an old roof. No supplied contract establishes that captions alone provide the central meaning.

setup_assessments.evidence: The setup combines six unrelated operational rules in one accumulating house, retains obsolete machinery, repeats identical staging, and provides no reset until the end.

violations.observation: The house is made to contain a separate archive, diff, test, authorization, routing, and rollback machine, stretching one world across unrelated mechanisms.
violations.smallest_structural_correction: Split s1 into distinct setups when the semantic rule changes; group only propositions that can visibly evolve under one rule.

violations.observation: Every new machine is added while all previous machines remain fully opaque and active, even though their claims are complete.
violations.smallest_structural_correction: At each semantic change, remove or replace the completed mechanism; carry forward only a result object needed by the next setup.

violations.observation: Later beats contain multiple unrelated active mechanism groups surrounding the current hero.
violations.smallest_structural_correction: Give each setup one dominant operational group and exclude completed groups from subsequent setups.

violations.observation: All six propositions retain the same central slab, small-left Bot, fixed wide camera, and paper wall/floor composition.
violations.smallest_structural_correction: Recompose at semantic boundaries using operation-specific dominant silhouettes, scales, or interface stages; preserve style identity without preserving the same blocking.

violations.observation: The house and accumulated machines function as undeclared persistent tokens without state changes, destinations, or story necessity.
violations.smallest_structural_correction: Define a lifecycle for one meaningful result token, such as a snapshot or changed output, and let only that token cross relevant cuts.

violations.observation: Previously completed machines remain visible and active solely to brand the argument, with no current causal or compositional function.
violations.smallest_structural_correction: Clear completed machinery at each reset and retain only environment cues or props that support the current action.

violations.observation: Six different semantic verbs occupy one setup, with the sole planned reset deferred until the end.
violations.smallest_structural_correction: Insert resets between incompatible rules—for example archive, diff inspection, behavior test, permission, routing, and restoration—while joining only genuinely dependent operations.

violations.observation: The current hero is introduced into a field where every prior mechanism remains fully active, so later dominant actions lack exclusive command of the frame.
violations.smallest_structural_correction: Deactivate and remove prior mechanisms before introducing each new hero, leaving at most a causally relevant result token as support.

limits: This data-only review evaluates planned structure and shot contracts. It cannot establish rendered hierarchy, actual mobile-glance performance, pixel visibility, motion execution, caption legibility, or listening/audio performance.
